Memory, not compute, is the true rate limiter of the Agentic era.

While the world remains fixated on GPU compute clusters, artificial intelligence is running headfirst into a massive physical barrier: the memory wall.

🧠 The Collapse of the Classical Model
For over half a century, computing has operated under the classical Von Neumann architecture—a clean, physical division between the compute processor (the "head") and memory storage (the "tape").

That model worked when software memory demands were modest. But frontier transformer models have upended the paradigm:
